A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' held the title [[Kuat of Kuat/Legends|Kuat of Kuat]], the leader of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], prior to his [[Kuat (person)|Kuat of Kuat]],<ref name="Slave Ship" /> and after his [[Kuat's grandfather|own father]].<ref name="Hard Merchandise" /> His son's [[Kuat's mother|mother]] [[Death/Legends|died]] giving birth to the Kuat of Kuat. His son believed that his genius was inherited from his father and predecessors, and remembered pieces of advice that his father had given to him.<ref name="Slave Ship" />

An [[Unidentified B-supervisor|individual]] who served as the lead operator of a massive crane at the KDY docks during this man's tenure later served as the [[Β-supervisor|β-supervisor]] during his son's tenure.<ref name="Hard Merchandise" />
